defs.def: to gain sth by your own efforts, ability or behaviour （通过努力、能力、行为表现）获得，得到

ex.s: Our brains use the system to acquire behavioural patterns regarding safe routes home, efficient food gathering and dangers to avoid.
ex.t: 我们的大脑利用这一系统习得有关安全回家路线、高效觅食以及需要避开的危险的行为模式。

ex.s: We acquire what we call a sense of right and wrong.
ex.t: 我们获得了所谓的是非感。

ex.s: My adviser saw this experience as a groundbreaking success, emphasising the collaborating skills I acquired.
ex.t: 我的导师将这次经历视为开创性的成功，并强调我所获得的协作能力。

ex.s: But how exactly they acquire such intention-reading abilities will be an exciting topic for future research.
ex.t: 但它们究竟如何获得这种读意图的能力，将是未来研究一个令人兴奋的课题。

ex.s: It has not acquired one permanent wrinkle after all its ripples.
ex.t: 在所有皱纹之后，它还没有获得一个永久性的皱纹。

ex.s: Remember, the knowledge you acquire and the diligent attitude you develop in high school will be invaluable in the real world.
ex.t: 请记住，您在高中获得的知识和培养的勤奋态度在现实世界中将非常宝贵。

defs.def: to obtain sth by buying or being given it 购得；获得；得到

ex.s: Although technology has changed the way we acquire friends, the meaning of friendship and our longing for friends remain the same.
ex.t: 虽然技术改变了我们结交朋友的方式，但友谊的意义和我们对朋友的渴望仍然是一样的。

ex.s: Speaker 2 (an English teacher): context literature recommend memorise the rules tips acquire unfamiliar a big headache beyondtheclassroom As an English teacher, I'd like to share some of my advice on ways to learn English well.
ex.t: 发言者2（一名英语老师）：语境、文学、推荐、记住规则、技巧、习得、不熟悉、一个大头疼、课堂之外。作为一名英语老师，我想分享一些我关于学好英语的建议。

ex.s: Pair Work Which of the following may help you acquire knowledge more effectively?Discuss inpairsandgiveexplanations.
ex.t: 配对工作以下哪项可以帮助您更有效地获取知识？讨论配对和具体说明。
